text: 港股黄金股盘初拉升上扬，赤峰黄金涨9.5%领衔，灵宝黄金、中国白银集团涨近8%，紫金黄金国际涨6%，中国黄金国际涨4.5%，招金矿业、紫金矿业涨4.4%，山东黄金、潼关黄金、珠峰黄金跟涨。 消息上，7月21日纽约尾盘现货黄金已涨1.76%报4078美元，22日早盘更连续突破4090、4100、4110、4120美元关口。中信期货认为，逢低买盘推动金价阶段性反弹，4000美元关口支撑显现，央行购金需求依然强劲为金价提供底部支撑。此前中金公司也指出，黄金股是金价的"放大器"，在反弹时上涨更多，具备盈利弹性与成长属性。
text_en: Hong Kong-listed gold stocks rose at open, Chifeng Jilong Gold up 9.5% leading, Lingbao Gold, China Silver Group up nearly 8%, Zijin Gold International up 6%, China Gold International up 4.5%, Zhaojin Mining, Zijin Mining up 4.4%, Shandong Gold, Tongguan Gold, Everest Gold followed. News: July 21 NY spot gold up 1.76% at $4,078, July 22 morning broke through $4,090, $4,100, $4,110, $4,120. CITIC Futures believes dip-buying drove gold's rebound, $4,000 support appeared, central bank gold demand remains strong. CICC noted gold stocks are 'amplifiers' of gold prices, rising more in rebounds with earnings flexibility and growth attributes.
